import sys
from collections import defaultdict

def findString(s):
    chars = sorted([ord(c) for c in set(s)], reverse=True)
    n = len(chars)
    dp = defaultdict(lambda: 1)
    prev = defaultdict(lambda: -1)
    
    max_len = 0
    best_start = -1
    
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i):
            diff = chars[i] - chars[j]
            if dp[j] + 1 > dp[i]:
                dp[i] = dp[j] + 1
                prev[i] = j
            if dp[i] > max_len or (dp[i] == max_len and chars[i] > chars[best_start]):
                max_len = dp[i]
                best_start = i
    
    result = []
    while best_start != -1:
        result.append(chr(chars[best_start]))
        best_start = prev[best_start]
    
    return ''.join(result)

input = sys.stdin.read().strip()
print(findString(input))
